hero.heading: How can we help?
hero.description: We're here to help you get the most out of HABOS. Find answers below or reach out directly.

email.label: Email Support
email.note: For all inquiries and support requests

items.question: What is HABOS?
items.answer: HABOS is the world's first Human-to-Agent Business Operating System. It replaces the dozen fragmented tools businesses juggle every day — scheduling, dispatch, invoicing, CRM, marketing, and more — with a single AI-native platform where everything shares context.

items.question: Who is HABOS built for?
items.answer: HABOS is built for service businesses (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, cleaning), solo founders, small teams, and creative agencies. If you're running a business with 1–50 people and tired of duct-taping tools together, HABOS is for you.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Join the waitlist on our homepage. Once you're in, onboarding takes about 15 minutes — connect your email, import your contacts, and HABOS starts learning your business immediately.

items.question: Do I need technical skills to set it up?
items.answer: Not at all. HABOS is designed for business owners, not developers. If you can send an email and use a calendar, you can run HABOS. The AI assistant walks you through setup.

items.question: How does dispatch work?
items.answer: Assign jobs to field technicians from a visual dispatch board. HABOS optimizes routes, avoids double-bookings, and notifies your team in real time. Technicians see their schedule, job details, and customer history on their phone.

items.question: Can my team invoice from the field?
items.answer: Yes. When a job is done, your technician can generate and send an invoice on-site — from their phone. No more paperwork piling up at the office.

items.question: How does the CRM connect to operations?
items.answer: Everything is connected. When a customer calls, you see their full history — past jobs, invoices, communications. When you dispatch a job, the technician sees that same context. No information gets lost between tools.

items.question: Can I track my team's job progress?
items.answer: Yes. See live job status updates, completion times, and notes from the field. HABOS gives you a clear overview of every active job across your entire team.

items.question: How do clients book appointments?
items.answer: Clients can self-book through a branded booking page. HABOS checks your availability, prevents double-bookings, and sends automatic confirmations and reminders.

items.question: Does the AI receptionist actually answer calls?
items.answer: Yes. The AI receptionist picks up calls 24/7, answers common questions, and books appointments directly into your calendar. If a call needs human attention, it routes to the right person.

items.question: Can I manage multiple team members' schedules?
items.answer: Absolutely. Each team member has their own availability, and HABOS coordinates across everyone. You see a unified view of your team's day, week, or month.

items.question: What is "The Airlock"?
items.answer: The Airlock is our safety principle: AI proposes, you decide. HABOS never sends an email, books a meeting, or charges a customer without your explicit approval. You stay in control of every action.

items.question: What can the AI assistant do?
items.answer: It drafts emails in your tone, prioritizes your tasks, summarizes meetings, generates invoices, suggests follow-ups, and answers questions using your full business context. Think of it as a smart assistant that actually knows your business.

items.question: How do voice notes work?
items.answer: Speak at 150 words per minute instead of typing at 40. HABOS transcribes your voice, then automatically turns it into the right thing — a task, a calendar event, a note, or a follow-up. Just talk and it handles the rest.

items.question: What is The Brain?
items.answer: The Brain connects data across all your HABOS tools — emails, CRM, invoices, calendar, notes — into one unified understanding. Ask it anything about your business and get an answer grounded in your actual data.

items.question: How many team members can I add?
items.answer: That depends on your plan. All plans support multiple team members. Join the waitlist to learn about founding member pricing and team limits.

items.question: Can I set roles and permissions?
items.answer: Yes. Assign roles so technicians see their jobs, office staff sees the full board, and admins manage everything. Each person gets the right level of access.

items.question: Does HABOS handle time tracking?
items.answer: Yes. Team members can clock in and out per job. You get clear reports on hours worked, job duration, and labor costs — all tied to specific customers and projects.

items.question: What does HABOS cost?
items.answer: We're currently in early access. Join the waitlist to lock in founding member pricing — no commitment required.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a trial period so you can experience HABOS with your real business data before committing. Details are shared when you get off the waitlist.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If HABOS isn't the right fit, contact us at <email>hello@habos.ai</email> or view our full <refund>Refund Policy</refund>.

items.question: What tools can HABOS replace?
items.answer: Most businesses replace 3–8 separate tools: scheduling (Calendly), CRM (HubSpot), invoicing (QuickBooks), dispatch (ServiceTitan), email marketing (Mailchimp), project management (Asana), and more. That's typically $300–800/month in savings.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Your data security is our top priority. We use encryption in transit and at rest, and we're fully GDPR compliant. Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for full details.

items.question: Who can see my business data?
items.answer: Only you and your authorized team members. We never sell, share, or use your data for advertising. Your business data stays yours.

items.question: Can I export my data?
items.answer: Yes. You can export your contacts, invoices, and other data at any time. We believe in no lock-in — your data belongs to you.

items.question: Does HABOS work on my phone?
items.answer: Yes. HABOS works on any modern browser — desktop, tablet, or phone. Your team can manage jobs, send invoices, and communicate with customers from anywhere.

items.question: Is there a dedicated mobile app?
items.answer: We're building native mobile apps for iOS and Android. In the meantime, the web app is fully optimized for mobile and works great on the go.

items.question: Can technicians use HABOS in the field without Wi-Fi?
items.answer: The core features work on any cellular connection. We're working on offline support so your team can view job details and capture notes even without connectivity.
